title: Who Deletes This: Ownership, deleteLater and the Loop That Has to Run
fallback: This lesson is about how Qt decides when an object is destroyed, so it needs Qt. Lesson 02-06 asks the same question in plain C++ with shared_ptr and weak_ptr, and the shape of the answer is the same: somebody owns the object, everybody else holds something that can tell them it has gone. Without Qt, do 02-06, and come back here when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: the three things you need to destroy a Qt object at the right time, on the right thread, and know that it happened
